name: INS-OFF-05 Profile shows the change(s) pending sync
fullName: INS-OFF — working offline INS-OFF-05 Profile shows the change(s) pending sync
description:
Working offline (manual chapter 9).

A simulator's network cannot be cut from a test, so the app is relaunched with
`-kaveE2ENetwork offline` (src/config/e2e.ts), which makes it behave exactly as
when NetInfo reports no connection: banner, outbox, "will sync" messages.
Relaunching online lets the outbox sync. Requests themselves are not blocked by
the simulator, so this covers the app's offline mode, not a real dead network.
